name: neon-green-beauty-on-yacht
image_purpose: show a distinctive vacation outfit and yacht setting

prompt.project_info: Photorealistic daytime outdoor lifestyle portrait on a yacht over open water.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with medium-to-long wavy black hair, medium skin tone, minimal natural makeup, and black rectangular sunglasses. She stands angled with one hand on the yacht railing and the other touching her hair, wearing a neon lime-green crochet-knit long-sleeve top and matching mid-calf skirt, black closed-toe heels, and small gold earrings.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 3:4 framing. Yacht wooden deck and polished metal railing in foreground, deep blue rippled water midground, modern glass-and-steel city skyline softly in the far background, clear pale-blue sky. Keep the relaxed soft smile and wind-swept hair.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural sunlight from camera-right, realistic highlights and shadows, bright coastal daytime atmosphere, slight background softness without artificial blur.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic outdoor lifestyle portrait, 3:4 aspect ratio, realistic crochet texture, hair movement, water ripples, and city detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 3:4 daytime yacht lifestyle portrait of one generic approved adult woman with wavy black hair, medium skin tone, black rectangular sunglasses, standing angled with one hand on a polished yacht railing and one touching wind-swept hair, neon lime-green crochet-knit top and matching mid-calf skirt, black closed-toe heels, small gold earrings, wooden deck, deep blue water, modern skyline, clear pale-blue sky, natural sunlight, bright coastal mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, transparent clothing, sexualized posing, fetish styling, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, plastic skin, CGI, illustration, illegible text, watermark, logo artifacts

assets.name: lime-yacht-fashion-reference
assets.usage: Match lime crochet outfit, hair, sunglasses, yacht railing, skyline, and bright coastal composition. Replaceable with another approved yacht-fashion reference.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve generic adult identity cues, outfit silhouette and knit texture, pose, yacht environment, skyline relationship, and daylight mood. Optional replacements may change hair, accessories, skyline, or outfit colors while retaining the yacht lifestyle concept. Remove or neutralize brand marks; no typography.
